docs.description: Text of the default trigger, and the accessible name of the panel (an aria-label on the element wins).
click: a dialog that opens on click and closes on an outside click or Escape. hover: a hover card that opens after a short delay on hover or keyboard focus and describes the trigger.
Side of the trigger, and the alignment along it. start and end are logical, so they mirror in right-to-left text. The panel flips and shifts to stay on screen.
Draw a pixel arrow that points at the middle of the trigger.
Open. View state the server may own: a changed attribute wins (open="false" closes), a removed one is ignored. Never reflected: use the open property, show() and hide() from the client.
Name reported in sb-open and sb-close (e.g. the field of a command).

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Your own trigger: a native button (or a link, in hover mode). It gets aria-expanded and aria-haspopup (click mode) or an aria-describedby to the content (hover mode), put back after every morph. Without it, a button shows label.

events.name: sb-open
events.description: The panel opened. detail: { name, reason }, reason being trigger, server or api.

events.name: sb-close
events.description: The panel closed. detail: { name, reason }: trigger, outside, escape, leave (hover mode), server or api.
